primary_outcome: seed-mean RMSE-AUC over the complete acquisition campaign
normalization: negative RMSE-AUC, min-max normalized within dataset, target set, downstream model, and evaluation property
interpretation_boundary: Panels use the source's normalized full-campaign RMSE-AUC and never select a favorable endpoint.
Only policy families with five released seeds for every dataset and target combination at the corresponding target count enter the bridge.
Targeted and untargeted evaluations are retained separately because target membership is known before acquisition.
Several panels reuse the same selected dataset across evaluation properties and downstream models; grouped holdouts therefore operate at the complete source-dataset level.
